title: Number Sets
description: Book-backed practice on set language, membership, subsets, union, intersection, complement, and number-set applications.

questions.q: Which of the following is a well-defined set?
questions.explanation: Odd integers can be clearly identified. Words like clever, beautiful, and tall are not precise enough without a rule.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a well-defined set?
questions.explanation: Good footballers is based on opinion unless a precise rule is given.

questions.q: List the elements of the set of odd positive integers less than 10.
questions.explanation: The odd positive integers less than 10 are 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.

questions.q: List the elements of the set of prime numbers less than 12.
questions.explanation: Prime numbers have exactly two factors. The primes less than 12 are 2, 3, 5, 7, and 11.

questions.q: If A = {2, 4, 6, 8}, which statement is true?
questions.explanation: 4 is one of the listed elements of A.

questions.q: If B = {a, e, i, o, u}, which statement is true?
questions.explanation: B is the set of vowels listed, and e is one of them.

questions.q: If A = {1, 2, 3}, how many elements has A?
questions.explanation: A has three elements: 1, 2, and 3.

questions.q: If S = {a, b, c, d}, find n(S).
questions.explanation: n(S) means the number of elements in S. There are 4 elements.

questions.q: Which set is the empty set?
questions.explanation: The empty set has no elements. {0} is not empty because it contains 0.

questions.q: How many subsets has the set {p, q}?
questions.explanation: A set with 2 elements has 2^2 = 4 subsets.

questions.q: How many subsets has the set {1, 2, 3}?
questions.explanation: A set with 3 elements has 2^3 = 8 subsets.

questions.q: How many proper subsets has the set {1, 2, 3}?
questions.explanation: A set with 3 elements has 8 subsets. All except the set itself are proper subsets, so there are 7.

questions.q: If A = {1, 2, 3, 4} and B = {3, 4, 5}, find A intersection B.
questions.explanation: The intersection contains elements common to both sets: 3 and 4.

questions.q: If A = {a, b, c} and B = {c, d}, find A union B.
questions.explanation: The union contains every distinct element in A or B.

questions.q: If U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} and A = {2, 4}, find the complement of A.
questions.explanation: The complement of A contains elements of U that are not in A.

questions.q: If P = {1, 2, 4, 5, 7} and Q = {3, 4, 7, 8}, find P intersection Q.
questions.explanation: The elements common to P and Q are 4 and 7.

questions.q: If P = {1, 2, 4, 5, 7} and Q = {3, 4, 7, 8}, find P union Q.
questions.explanation: The union lists all distinct elements from both sets.

questions.q: If U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8} and P = {1, 2, 4, 5, 7}, find the complement of P.
questions.explanation: The elements in U but not in P are 3, 6, and 8.

questions.q: If A = {2, 3, 4, 5, 10} and B = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10}, find A intersection B.
questions.explanation: Every element of A is also in B, so A intersection B is A.

questions.q: If A is a subset of B, what is A intersection B?
questions.explanation: When A is contained in B, all elements of A are common to A and B.

questions.q: If A is a subset of B, what is A union B?
questions.explanation: Since B already contains all elements of A, the union is B.

questions.q: If D(24) is the set of factors of 24, which option lists D(24)?
questions.explanation: The positive factors of 24 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 24.

questions.q: If D(32) is the set of factors of 32, which option lists D(32)?
questions.explanation: The positive factors of 32 are 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32.

questions.q: Using factor sets, find the HCF of 24 and 32.
questions.explanation: Common factors of 24 and 32 are {1, 2, 4, 8}. The highest is 8.
The common factors of 15 and 18 are 1 and 3.

questions.q: Using factor sets, find the HCF of 15 and 18.
questions.explanation: The common factors are {1, 3}. The highest common factor is 3.

questions.q: Which set contains only natural numbers?
questions.explanation: Natural numbers are counting numbers such as 1, 2, 3, and 4.

questions.q: Which set contains only integers?
questions.explanation: Integers include negative whole numbers, zero, and positive whole numbers.

questions.q: Which number is irrational?
questions.explanation: sqrt(2) cannot be written exactly as a ratio of two integers.

questions.q: Which number is rational?
questions.explanation: 7/9 is a ratio of two integers, so it is rational.

questions.q: If A = {x: x is an even number less than 10}, which option lists A?
questions.explanation: The positive even numbers less than 10 are 2, 4, 6, and 8.

questions.q: If B = {x: x is a prime number less than 10}, which option lists B?
questions.explanation: The prime numbers less than 10 are 2, 3, 5, and 7.

questions.q: If U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} and A = {1, 3, 5}, what is the complement of A?
questions.explanation: The complement contains elements of U that are not in A: 2, 4, and 6.

questions.q: If A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {4, 5}, find A intersection B.
questions.explanation: A and B have no common elements, so their intersection is the empty set.

questions.q: If A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {4, 5}, find A union B.
questions.explanation: The union contains all elements in A or B.

questions.q: Which statement describes De Morgan's law for complement of a union?
options: Complement of A union B equals complement of A intersection complement of B
Complement of A union B equals complement of A union complement of B
A union B equals A intersection B
A intersection B equals complement of A
questions.explanation: De Morgan's law says the complement of a union is the intersection of the complements.

questions.q: Which statement describes De Morgan's law for complement of an intersection?
options: Complement of A intersection B equals complement of A union complement of B
Complement of A intersection B equals complement of A intersection complement of B
A intersection B equals A union B
questions.explanation: De Morgan's law says the complement of an intersection is the union of the complements.

questions.q: If A = {5, 10, 15, 20, 25} and B = {5, 25, 125, 625}, find A intersection B.
questions.explanation: The elements common to both sets are 5 and 25.
The union lists all distinct elements from A and B.

questions.q: If U = {prime numbers less than 20}, which option lists U?
questions.explanation: The prime numbers less than 20 are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, and 19.
